name: llm-tg-bot
description: Telegram bot powered by an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API with a configuration dashboard

scripts.build:modules: npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-registry && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-utils && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-addressing-detection && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-search-decision && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-web-search && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-memory && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-memory-db && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-link-fetch && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-sticker-selection && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-mood-evaluation && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-mood-evaluation-db && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-history && npm run build -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-history-db
scripts.dev: node scripts/write-build-info.mjs && concurrently -n server,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.build: node scripts/write-build-info.mjs && npm run build:modules && npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-registry && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-utils && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-addressing-detection && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-search-decision && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-web-search && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-memory && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-link-fetch && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-sticker-selection && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-mood-evaluation && npm run test -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-history && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:llm: npm run test:llm -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-addressing-detection && npm run test:llm -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-search-decision && npm run test:llm -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-memory && npm run test:llm -w @llm-tg-bot/modules-mood-evaluation && npm run test:llm -w server
